Description: Job Description Why GSW? The Global Solutions Wholesale (GSW) application is the Backoffice platform used by the operations team to manage wholesale assets in Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Mexico, and Peru. GSW has been designed to ensure that the wholesale business in all countries is able to increase the efficiency of country operations, by assisting in providing a better service to dealers whilst, at the same time, maintaining regulatory compliance. The GSW program team designs, delivers, and provides sustain capability solutions that enable and optimize Wholesale operations across Latin America. The team ensures that business processes are standardized, scalable, and compliant with local requirements while supporting market needs. By driving system integration, process efficiency, and data consistency, the program enables the organization to operate with greater agility and control.
